text.text_excerpt: Best crazy late night scene in the Uptown area!!! People of all ages end up at F&M's for fun into the wee hours of the morning. Always a good time with tasty cheese fries and pool table dancing. Sometimes it gets crazy crowded but some of the best bartenders in the city keep things moving smoothly. Occasionally some out of town idiots try to cause trouble and start fights as they have stayed up way past their bed times and don't know how to behave themselves on New Orleans time but usually just a lot of people having a really good time dancing to mostly great music with the occasional crappy rap song thrown in. The men's bathrooms can get filthy beyond all legends and who knows what foul ...

First of all, I don't know why people are giving this bar such negative reviews. This is by far one of the funnest bars to go to. I come here atleast once a week. I love to dance, and they play the BEST music. If a song comes on that I don't particularly care for, I usually just migrate to another room. They have the BEST cheese fries in the city of New Orleans. And you have to dance on the pool table atleast once in your life: it is the F&M's right of passage. You have to come here on a Friday or Saturday night after about 1 am. You know you get here too early when you see a leopard print pool table. I don't think I've ever had a bad time here.

I used to be ashamed...Like I was hiding some dirty secret. When people would bring up F & M Patio Bar, I would agree, "psh" and throw in a "who goes there anymore?!" followed by another "psh." I came out of the closet a little over 3 years ago, and professed my guilty pleasure for this New Orleans dirty little dive. But once you're passed the age of 25, you have to call it Fump & Manny's so you sound more sophisticated. I love dancing on the covered pool table, I have voraciously inhaled cheese fries at 3:00 AM in the morning and I have gone to Fump & Manny's probably 1-3 times a month for the last 3 years.
